title: Evolith Satellite Record Schema
description: Defines the canonical entity for a satellite repository registered in the Evolith provisioning system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the satellite record

name.description: Human-readable name for the satellite repository

owner.description: GitHub organization or user that owns the satellite repository

repoUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the satellite repository on GitHub

cloneUrl.description: HTTPS clone URL for the satellite repository

sshUrl.description: SSH clone URL for the satellite repository

topology.description: Architecture topology of the satellite. Well-known values: monolith, modular, micro, distributed, custom

phase.description: Current SDLC phase of the satellite (e.g. f1, f2, f3, f4, f5)

status.description: Lifecycle status of the satellite record

mode.description: Whether this satellite was created by Evolith or adopted from an existing repository

coreVersion.description: Version of Evolith Core this satellite is linked to

parentCorePath.description: Filesystem path to the parent Evolith Core repository, when running locally

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the satellite's purpose

linkedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the satellite was linked to Evolith Core

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this satellite record was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this satellite record was last updated

metadata.description: Arbitrary extensible metadata for the satellite record
